## Invitations

During the reporting period, 1539 invitations were sent to prospective attendees. Attendance totalled 198 people, representing a rate of 12.9 per cent. The figures provide a straightforward summary of the response to the invitation activity and indicate the number of people who attended following contact.

The invitation process included direct text-message contact. This supported the wider approach to keeping people informed and provided an additional way to reach those invited.

## Contact

An SMS accompanied 1336 invitations. A reminder message was also sent to 1336 people. These contacts formed part of the follow-up arrangements associated with the invitations and attendance.

Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments, helping maintain contact after the initial invitation and reminder messages. This ongoing contact supports continued engagement with the service and provides an opportunity to follow up with people who did not attend.

Prepared by G. Evans.
